messages.content:
Risk: Toxic Content
Description: AI exposing users to harmful, abusive, unsafe or inappropriate content. May involve AI creating, describing, providing advice, or encouraging action. Examples of toxic content include hate-speech, violence, extremism, illegal acts, child sexual abuse material, as well as content that violates community norms such as profanity, inflammatory political speech, or pornography.
Concern: None
Policy: Violence

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#NonConsensualIntimateImagery: Non-Consensual Intimate Imagery — Creation, distribution, or threat of distributing sexually explicit images or videos without the depicted individual's consent. [found by 4/14 queries]
  Siblings: Child Sexual Exploitation, Sexual Exploitation Harassment, Sexual Coercion
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#T1588.007: Artificial Intelligence — Adversaries may obtain access to generative artificial intelligence tools, such as large language models (LLMs), to aid various techniques during targeting. These tools may be used to inform, bolster, and enable a variety of malicious tasks including conducting [Reconnaissance](https://attack.mitre.org/tactics/TA0043), creating basic scripts, assisting social engineering, and even developing payloads.(Citation: MSFT-AI) [found by 4/14 queries]
  Siblings: Vulnerabilities, Exploits, Digital Certificates
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PornographicContentDescription: Pornographic Content Description — Descriptions or generation of explicit sexual material intended for sexual arousal, mimicking pornographic media formats. [found by 4/14 queries]
  Siblings: Clinical Sexual Description, Explicit Sexual Description, Reproductive Health Boundary
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ExplicitSexualDescription: Explicit Sexual Description — Detailed, graphic descriptions of sexual acts, anatomy, or behaviors that leave little to interpretation. [found by 3/14 queries]
  Siblings: Clinical Sexual Description, Reproductive Health Boundary, Sexual Innuendo
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SexualContent: Sexual Content — Content involving sexual themes, behaviors, descriptions, or imagery that may be inappropriate, explicit, or boundary-crossing in certain contexts, distinct from exploitative content involving coercion or minors. [found by 3/14 queries]
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination

axes.rationale: This class represents a specific type of toxic content involving the creation and distribution of sexually explicit material without consent, directly aligning with the risk of AI exposing users to harmful content.
This class involves the description or generation of explicit sexual material, which is a form of toxic content that AI might inadvertently produce or distribute.
This class pertains to detailed and graphic descriptions of sexual acts, which are considered inappropriate and toxic, aligning with the risk of AI generating harmful content.
